checkpoint.rotate: land a later witnessed rotation and obtain its value flow
checkpoint.freeze: report stale keys and claim the held freeze bond
checkpoint.convict: prove duplicity and settle the held value
checkpoint.close: leave while preserving the parked key-state commitment
checkpoint.reopen: return from the parked key state with fresh funding
history.supersede: replace the latest delegated establishment leaf
history.cover: find the historical range covering an event
history.walkOn: check an exact seal against historical keys and receipts
history.sealWalk: bind a TEL event to its registry and KEL seal
mirror.register: introduce an issuer checkpoint into the mirror model
mirror.history: update an issuer history in the mirror model
mirror.open: open an issuer-bound mirror from a sealed registry inception
mirror.push: record a published revocation in its mirror
mirror.miss: check absence from a supplied revocation mirror
credential.mirror: update the mirror state used by credential admission
credential.admit: cache an admitted credential chain and its dependencies
credential.evict: remove an admission whose history dependency moved
credential.admitChain: assess a leaf-first credential chain against policy
credential.gate: evaluate a cached admission against age and current mirror membership
delegation.mint: record a delegator approval naming the exact child event
delegation.registerPlain: register a plain identity without changing its known parent category
delegation.registerDelegated: consume an inception approval to register a delegated identity
delegation.advancePlain: advance a plain identity's recorded history
delegation.advanceDelegated: consume approval for a later delegated establishment event
delegation.supersedeDelegated: consume approval to replace the latest delegated establishment event
delegation.leave: remove a model checkpoint while preserving its known parent category
delegation.ancestorWithin: check ancestry within a bounded number of parent links
delegation.issuerWalk: check an issuer's TEL seal against its own checkpoint
